stimulus.text: The museum's new exhibit features tools from three continents ______ each display case is arranged to highlight how similar problems were solved independently.

stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
rationale: Two independent clauses must be joined by a semicolon, a period, or a coordinating conjunction; the semicolon is the only boundary that avoids a comma splice or run-on.
